edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Personal Space for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Naafiri Hounds' Pursuit (R) is 110s at rank 1: the lock-on pack dash starts her dive — it feeds your Gloom marks, and a Doom-loaded W fears it. Step up on its downtime. - Budget W Personal Space (16s) for emergencies and the R (140s) for opportunities.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: With W spent on spacing, the next Hounds' Pursuit arrives unanswered — past the river the pack re-engages before your fear is back.

notes: cooldowns: dropped the unverified 'stand near minions to body-block the hounds' claim — Hounds' Pursuit is her R per the 26.15 kit (champion-targeted lock-on dash); minion body-block is not in Riot's text and needsResearch is empty, so it stays unasserted. Added real cooldowns (R 110s, W 16s).
